# GlobalS app

`GlobalS.html` is the whole GlobalS app in one page, built by GitHub Actions from `main`
(`tools/build-single.mjs`). The small GlobalS starter file loads it from here. **This branch is
replaced on every update** — don't commit to it.

To use GlobalS directly, download it from the
[latest release](https://github.com/GrantWally120/GlobalS/releases/latest/download/GlobalS.html)
and double-click it.
